subject: cast.refused
note: CAST to Uuid has no MySQL equivalent that preserves meaning

subject: filter_clause.refused
note: MySQL has no FILTER (WHERE ..) on aggregates

subject: fn:concat.refused
note: PostgreSQL concat() ignores NULLs; MySQL CONCAT() returns NULL if any argument is NULL

subject: fn:substr.refused
note: start positions before 1 behave differently (PostgreSQL clips the length, MySQL returns '')

subject: fn:sum.refused
note: this target cannot honour an ORDER BY inside this aggregate

subject: json_get_text.refused
note: MySQL JSON access uses path expressions ('$.key'); translating a key to a path is not implemented

subject: returning.refused
note: MariaDB supports RETURNING on INSERT and DELETE only, not on UPDATE

subject: trim.refused
note: PostgreSQL trims a set of characters, MySQL a repeated string: they agree only for one character

subject: upsert_where.refused
note: ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE has no WHERE clause
